test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A retailer allows a 10% discount on the marked price. What price (in ₹) must be marked on an item whose cost price is ₹626 to make a profit of 35%?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹626

Profit = 35%

Discount = 10%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

Marked Price (MP) = SP × 100 ÷ (100 - Discount%)

**Calculations:**

⇒ SP = 626 × (100 + 35) ÷ 100

⇒ SP = 626 × 135 ÷ 100

⇒ SP = 845.1

Now, MP = 845.1 × 100 ÷ (100 - 10)

⇒ MP = 845.1 × 100 ÷ 90

⇒ MP = 84510 ÷ 90

⇒ MP = 939

**∴ The marked price should be ₹939.**
